title: Northstar battery study
text: Northstar Labs tested a battery with 120 watt-hours of capacity. The prototype powered a sensor for 6 hours at a constant average draw.

title: River restoration notes
text: The Cedar River restoration project began in 2018. Its public report lists 14 restored wetlands and a 35 kilometer monitoring route.

title: Orbital mechanics primer
text: A low Earth orbit satellite circles Earth about every 90 minutes. The example satellite completes 16 orbits during a 24-hour day.

title: Library inventory memo
text: The West Annex catalog contains 240 history books, 180 science books, and 60 reference books. A quarterly audit found 12 items in repair.

title: Community garden plan
text: The Maple Street garden has 8 plots. Each plot receives 15 liters of water per week, and the rain barrel stores 200 liters.

title: Museum visitor summary
text: The Harbor Museum recorded 1,250 visitors on Saturday and 975 on Sunday. Student tickets cost 8 dollars and adult tickets cost 14 dollars.

title: Regional rail timetable
text: The Green Line train travels 84 kilometers in 70 minutes. A transfer at Pine Junction adds a scheduled 12-minute connection.

title: School recycling report
text: Brookfield School collected 360 kilograms of paper in April and 420 kilograms in May. The goal for June is 500 kilograms.
